verdict.rationale: The evidence documents AWS's IaC surface: CloudFormation templates provision resources, CDK deploys through CloudFormation, and stacks can be deleted. However, it describes only a greenfield flow, with no mention of importing existing resources into stacks or detecting drift. The axis clearly applies to AWS, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, existing resources can come under IaC — documented import/drift workflows instead of a greenfield-only story
